info.title: Health Insurance CloudWatch Logs Fetcher
info.description: Fetches and filters application logs from AWS CloudWatch Logs for Health Insurance microservices

get.description: Searches CloudWatch Logs for entries matching a filter pattern within a time range. Use this when the user asks about errors, exceptions, timeouts, or policy/claim service failures. Available log groups: /eks/health-insurance/pods (us-east-1) for pod-level application logs from the health insurance microservices (claims, auth, gateway, frontend, policies, members), /aws/eks/healthshield-eks/cluster for Kubernetes control plane logs.

parameters.name: filter_pattern
parameters.description: The search pattern to filter logs. Examples: ERROR, 503, timeout, connection refused, OutOfMemory, Unauthorized, Failed

parameters.name: log_group_name
parameters.description: The CloudWatch Log Group name. Use /eks/health-insurance/pods for health insurance pod logs. Use /aws/eks/healthshield-eks/cluster for Kubernetes control plane logs.

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: How many hours back to search. Use 1 for recent issues, 6 for trends, 24 for daily patterns.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region where the logs are stored. Default is us-east-1.
